stories.title: Flintshire Council heads for £7.6m overspend as social care costs climb
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is on course to overspend by £7.6m this year, with social care and out of county placements driving most of the shortfall. The latest budget monitoring report, covering the first six months of 2026/27, says the council will use the last £2.7m in its budget risk reserve to bring the gap down

stories.title: Drug driving offences down in North Wales after record 2025
stories.summary: The number of drug driving offences recorded by North Wales Police has fallen by 29 per cent this year, after rising for two years in a row. stories.title: Second World War air raid shelter under Chester’s St Michael’s Arcade to open on Remembrance Sunday
stories.summary: A Second World War air raid shelter beneath St Michael’s Arcade in Chester will open to visitors on Remembrance Sunday. Heritage Chester is opening the basement from 1pm to 3pm on Sunday, 8 November, for one afternoon only. stories.title: North Wales and North West police commissioners unite against plans for regional forces
